audience: Owner launch decision pending; current access unchanged

items.impact: Live game depends on owner's PC, local PG/PHP and reverse tunnel
items.reproduction: Inspect engine/bin/start-local.ps1, keep-public-beta.ps1 and live PIDs 22352/81276/2812
items.acceptance: Hosted stack remains ready with owner PC unavailable; restore rehearsed away from live DB
items.evidence: Read-only registered relay VPS has no PHP or Docker, 2026-10-14

items.impact: Owner signed-in access is not invited/public tester access; current beta owner shortcut must not become ordinary-player admin authority
items.reproduction: Anonymous request reaches Vercel authentication; signed-in browser reaches JSON health
items.acceptance: Two ordinary invited/public accounts enter intended layer and cannot enter admin/playtest
items.evidence: v104 live-verification.json; isolated production-mode first-session access checks

items.impact: GitHub main alone would rebuild older code than working deployment
items.reproduction: Local and remote main 4bec6cb with 224 dirty entries; v104 built from export
items.acceptance: Clean committed checkout builds identical accepted world assets and verified runtime

items.impact: Editing crime rewards can silently remove its level requirement
items.reproduction: Old form omitted level_required; backend defaulted to 1
items.acceptance: EN/AR form saves explicit gate and late response preserves newer field

items.impact: Delayed save changes the editor after switching categories
items.reproduction: Create entry then select another category before response
items.acceptance: Selected editor and pending fields retained; saved entry resumes by canonical ID

items.impact: Rejected character assets retry forever and stalled loads lack deadline
items.reproduction: Actual baseline rejected load plus 25 heartbeat repaints caused 26 loader calls
items.acceptance: One failed request, bounded timeout, explicit localized retry, cleanup and render pause
items.evidence: Media commit a92e18b; 64 focused tests; actual AR context-loss/recovery inspected

items.impact: New sections inherit arbitrary scroll and keyboard focus
items.reproduction: Go from scrolled Crimes to Bank; focus remains BODY
items.acceptance: Heading gets focus; Back restores matching saved viewport; rapid navigation fenced
items.evidence: 8 navigation tests and 19 AR phone route checks

items.impact: Historical consequential receipts cannot identify exact immutable release rules after rollback
items.reproduction: CrimeSucceeded and ProgressionAction payloads contain correlation but no pinned content release
items.acceptance: Action records exact rules used despite concurrent publish; rollback retains ledger/history
items.evidence: Current event payload code and Studio publish/rollback proof

items.impact: A route count does not certify a complete beta journey
items.reproduction: First-session browser crime/reload tested; remaining full route interactions not yet certified
items.acceptance: Two ordinary browser sessions complete first/return play, progression, economy, EN/AR mobile and error paths
items.evidence: 45 ordinary HTTP checks; 37 Studio checks; 201 isolated PG checks

items.impact: Backup configuration without restore proof is not recovery
items.reproduction: Current full launch restore not rehearsed in this pass
items.acceptance: Named isolated restore matches durable state; measured RTO/RPO; no live restore

items.impact: Capacity/device tier not yet measured for intended audience
items.reproduction: Prior finite page/read checks are not launch player-count proof
items.acceptance: Recorded profile, workload, concurrency, p50/p95, media weights/FPS/CLS and stop thresholds

items.impact: Registered image/model selection is not arbitrary asset upload; crime image authoring absent
items.reproduction: Studio uses packaged paths/model IDs and crime schema has no image
items.acceptance: Truthful operator capabilities; validate intended asset workflow without unsafe upload

items.impact: Location scenes and full outfit/equipment motion still need in-context review
items.reproduction: One AR suit and viewer failure inspected; all shipped motion not yet visually accepted
items.acceptance: Inspect every outfit/weapon, head/hands/shoes and distinct usable location screens
